blueprint_book.description:
With all of these make sure that the belts are fully saturated before enabling for best test results. This is important since the curves around the outside connecting two parallel lanes will cause the inner lane to travel faster than the outer lane due to it being shorter. Since the clocks are exact, they assume a non moving belt when picking up and will fail to pickup items due to this if you do not first saturate the transport lines.

-designed by abucnasty
